notes.title: Planned Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Cadets!

We hope this message finds you well and filled with holiday cheer. We are writing to inform you of a slight adjustment to our upcoming launch schedule.

After careful consideration and to ensure the optimal success of our launch, we have decided to reschedule the release date from the initially planned date of December 24th to the new launch date of January 6th.

The primary reason for this adjustment is the overlapping time-frame with the Steam Winter Sale, which will be taking place from December 24th to January 4th. This sale is a significant event, and we believe that the potential adverse impact on our visibility during this period could be mitigated by shifting our launch to a slightly later date.

By making this decision, we aim to maximise the exposure and reception of No Pressure: Hive War without being overshadowed by the flurry of activities associated with the Steam Winter Sale. We want to ensure that our community and potential player-base have the best opportunity to engage with and fully enjoy the launch of this title.

We appreciate your understanding and support in this matter. Our team is dedicated to delivering an outstanding experience, and we believe that this adjustment will contribute to a more successful launch overall.

Thank you for your continued enthusiasm and patience. We look forward to sharing this exciting moment with you on January 6th.

Wishing you a joyful holiday season, Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

Best regards,
Ethereal Team
